model_annotation: The plot displays two separate line charts comparing the training rewards over steps for two different models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, under easy and hard training set conditions. Both charts share the same axes: the x-axis represents “Steps” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100; the y-axis represents “Training Rewards” on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 (in the top chart) or 0.0 to 0.2 (in the bottom chart). In the top chart, labeled “Easy Training Set,” the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by step 500, showing a steady increase with minor fluctuations. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Easy”) also starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.4 by step 500, generally following a similar trajectory but with slightly higher rewards and more variability. In the bottom chart, labeled “Hard Training Set,” the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) starts near 0.0, rises slightly to about 0.02 at step 100, then declines sharply to near 0.0 by step 200 and remains near zero throughout. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Hard”) starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.1 at step 100, then continues to increase steadily to approximately 0.2 by step 500, with some fluctuations.
